title: JailbreakHunter: A Visual Analytics Approach for Jailbreak Prompts Discovery from Large-Scale Human-LLM Conversational Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on a visual analytics tool for security and safety researchers to identify jailbreak prompts in conversation datasets. While the tool is used to find content that violates safety policies (such as hate speech or sexual content), it is fundamentally a security/visualization research paper and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical reasoning systems.
